newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares head lower once more.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares head lower once more.

text.p: Shares in crisis-hit Italian information technology group Olivetti forged a new record low at 562 lire on the Milan bourse on Tuesday, 6.85 percent off Monday's closing price.
Olivetti shares, which fell nearly 20 percent on Monday after two days' suspension on the stock market, had struggled back into positive territory from a weak start.
The stock was trading 5.69 percent down at 569 lire by 1445 GMT.

Late on Monday stock market watchdog Consob gave Olivetti 24 hours to answer seven questions about its 1996 half year accounts and the market is waiting to hear of further developments concerning this.
Traders said foreign investors, particularly London based ones, were selling heavily, using the earlier slight strengthening in the stock price to get rid of the share.
